New to Qwirkle? Here’s a quick refresher +

Lines share one color or one shape, with no duplicates and at most six tiles. Each turn adds tiles to a single connected line; existing tiles may sit between the new ones.

Score every tile in each line created or extended. A six-tile line earns 6 extra points. Emptying your rack when the bag is empty earns another 6.

On an empty board, play your largest matching set. The analyzer assumes you are the starting player.
